original_test_intent: Verify every approved InfiniBand port tolerates exactly five controlled down/up cycles, reports the expected physical/link state, restores peer connectivity and remains healthy.
original_method: Use the vendor-approved port transition on an isolated HCA port while collecting bounded peer/RDMA health, ibstat/ibstatus/ibv_devinfo, counters and full logs for each of five cycles, then restore final state.
manual_activity: User/operator approves safe HCA ports, peer/fabric impact, transition method and recovery; agent may run exactly five cycles only within that contract.
required_inputs: Approved LinkUp/Disabled mapping to ibstat/ibstatus states
Five-cycle dwell, bounded ping/RDMA probe and recovery timeout
Non-critical path confirmation, OOB/console, rollback/recovery and protected evidence
safety_requirements: Exclude management, storage and production fabric paths
Prove independent recovery and capture baseline before first transition
Stop on access/fabric loss, unexpected state, peer impact, timeout or device error
Restore final state and preserve all cycle logs
Do not auto-reboot, reset other ports, retry after failure or truncate evidence
agent_execution_scope: Collect full HCA/port/peer and health baseline
Execute exactly five approved cycles with bounded peer/RDMA monitoring
Capture state, counters and logs per transition and verify final restoration
Do not select targets/method, touch other ports, auto-recover or issue verdict
engineer_actions: Approve target, transition method, state mapping and limits
Review five-cycle evidence and issue PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Diagnostic commands are relevant but insufficient because they never flap the link, verify five recoveries or preserve complete ibv_devinfo.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Apply the approved per-port transition exactly five times and collect untruncated ibstat/ibstatus/ibv_devinfo, counters, bounded peer/RDMA health and logs for every down/up state.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: OS link down/up, ping, physical state, five cycles per port, LinkUp/Disabled and 10/10 timing fields are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Run an identity-locked, isolated five-cycle IB transition matrix with explicit state equivalence and bounded recovery measurement.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds safe targeting, vendor transition authority, complete evidence and abort/recovery controls.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: All active flap, peer and physical-state coverage remains; read-only snapshots cannot substitute.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: IB subnet management, port mode and shared storage paths may change recovery behavior; project topology governs safe execution.

project_override_considerations: Project fabric policy must define the safe port, subnet-manager interaction and valid LinkUp/Disabled equivalence.
expected_evidence: Five timestamped down/up cycles with bounded peer/RDMA results
Complete per-cycle states/counters/capabilities and system/SEL logs
Final restored fabric health and abort/recovery disposition

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Master and GPT V2 clearly identify InfiniBand link-flap coverage; DeepSeek is incomplete but not contradictory.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Execution awaits project safety inputs, while static review is complete.

review_improvement: Converts a passive IB snapshot into the required auditable five-cycle fabric recovery test with bounded impact.
independent_technical_reasoning: A single Active/LinkUp snapshot does not show that a port can transition down and recover five times or that peer/RDMA paths survive. Each cycle must couple local physical/state evidence with end-to-end fabric health because the port may report link before routing or RDMA service is usable.
